en-US.title: Logisim Mobile
en-US.shortDescription: Design and simulate digital circuits on phones and tablets.
en-US.fullDescription: Build digital logic circuits, inspect signals, and run simulations. Open and export supported .circ projects, edit properties, and explore included examples such as SAP-1. Optional desktop companion operations require pairing and a user action. This independent port has a documented compatibility scope and is not affiliated with upstream Logisim Evolution.

pt-BR.title: Logisim Mobile
pt-BR.shortDescription: Crie e simule circuitos digitais no celular e no tablet.
pt-BR.fullDescription: Monte circuitos lógicos digitais, inspecione sinais e execute simulações. Abra e exporte projetos .circ compatíveis, edite propriedades e explore exemplos incluídos, como o SAP-1. As operações opcionais no companion desktop exigem pareamento e uma ação do usuário. Este port independente tem um escopo de compatibilidade documentado e não é afiliado ao projeto upstream Logisim Evolution.

knownFlows: Circuit editing and ordinary simulation run locally; workspace and preferences are stored in app-private storage.
Users choose documents and assets through system pickers. Export/share actions send selected content to the destination chosen in the system interface.

Optional companion requests send selected circuit/source/tool inputs to a paired host after a user action. The host may run local tools or access a network endpoint explicitly enabled for that operation.
Pairing sends a token to the chosen endpoint and retrieves capabilities. Local editing does not require pairing.
No hosted service, cloud account, automatic LAN discovery, or telemetry endpoint is configured by the interop policy. This is source evidence, not a final Google Play Data safety declaration.
